description: server/search/create-search-index-ui.md and create-search-index-rest-api.md name a 'Search Admin' privilege; server/fts/fts-introduction.md separately names 'FTS Admin' and 'FTS Searcher' privileges. Both were minted as distinct concepts (extracted by two different, independent agents who could not see each other's output) with an explicit note that they may be the same or related roles under the fts/ (old) vs search/ (new) product naming. No page states the mapping either way - needs a subject-matter expert, not more extraction.
resolution: Resolved from the docs, without an SME. roles.md states the mapping directly: 'Role: Search Admin (fts_admin)' and 'Role: Search Reader (fts_searcher)'. So the search/ tree's 'Search Admin' and the fts/ tree's 'FTS Admin' are one role, internal name fts_admin, and 'FTS Searcher' is the role labelled Search Reader. The POC's two ids were folded into concepts/role/fts-admin.json (aliasing privilege:search-admin) and concepts/role/fts-searcher.json. The original note said this 'needs a subject-matter expert, not more extraction' - that was wrong in a specific and repeatable way: it needed extraction from a different GENRE of page. Ten rounds of reference-page extraction could not answer it; the role catalogue answered it in one line. The residual documentation issue - that the same role is called Search Admin in search/ and FTS Admin in fts/ - stands on its own and is now covered by server-role-label-does-not-match-internal-name.
